description: This Java class `EnableConnectionLogsResponse` is a response object for handling the reply to an `EnableConnectionLogs` command in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It encapsulates the connection ID, headers, and parsing logic for JSON serialization/deserialization, adhering to Eclipse Ditto's JSON command response structure.
